correctness.rationale: Exact stationary masses yield the center/leaf entropy expressions. Entropy maximality gives strict root dominance; derivative sign gives the unique hub optimum. The collision entropy formula and bounds place every leaf optimum between m^(-4/5) and m^(-7/10) for large m; uniform differentiation forces m^(3/4) p->1 and entropy gain m^(-3/4). All endpoints and existence are handled analytically. The package checker passed 185 direct stationary-matrix/derivative/scaling assertions, which do not replace the proof.
